rules: Do NOT delete or rewrite feature items. Only set passes true/false and append notes.
Only set passes=true after completing end-to-end verification for that feature.
passes=true means YOU verified it this session, not just that old tests exist.
Add new features as new entries. Do not merge into existing ones.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: LINE OAuth + email/password login, JWT sessions, profile completion flow
steps: Open /login
Log in with credentials or LINE OAuth
Verify redirect to app home
Verify session persists on refresh
Verify incomplete profile redirects to /complete-profile
features.evidence: E2E e2e/1-auth.spec.ts covers login flow. Unit tests: 143/143 pass (2026-02-23).
features.notes: 12-hour max session age. LINE is primary provider.

features.name: Role-Based Permissions
features.description: DB-backed RBAC with 8 roles, per-module read/write permissions, in-memory cache
steps: Open /admin/users/roles
Toggle a permission for a non-ADMIN role
Save changes
Verify the role now has/lacks access to the corresponding admin page
Verify ADMIN always has full access regardless of DB entries
features.evidence: E2E e2e/11-admin-role-permissions.spec.ts (4 tests). Unit tests pass. Verified 2026-02-23.
features.notes: ADMIN bypasses all checks. 60s cache TTL.

features.name: Event Management
features.description: CRUD for single/series events with sessions, computed status lifecycle
steps: Open /admin/events/new, create a single event
Verify it appears in /admin/events list
Edit the event, change title and add sessions
Verify public /events page shows OPEN events
Delete the event, verify removal
features.evidence: E2E e2e/2-admin-events.spec.ts + e2e/3-public-event.spec.ts. Unit tests pass.
features.notes: Status computed from session dates: PLANNING → OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED.

features.name: Registration
features.description: Event registration with auto-waitlist and auto-promotion on cancellation
steps: Open /events/[eventId] as a logged-in user
Click register, verify REGISTERED status
Cancel registration, verify CANCELLED status
Fill event to maxParticipants, register another user, verify WAITLISTED
Cancel one registration, verify waitlisted user promoted to REGISTERED

features.name: Attendance Tracking
features.description: Per-session check-in, late marking, bulk check-in, attendance matrix
steps: Open /admin/attendance, select an event
Check in a user for a session
Mark a user as late with minutes
Use bulk check-in for multiple users
Verify attendance matrix shows correct data
features.notes: Attendance summary returns user × session matrix.

features.name: QR Code Check-in
features.description: Public QR code check-in page per event session
steps: Open /admin/share, generate QR for a session
Scan/open QR link at /check-in/[sessionId]
Verify check-in recorded for authenticated user
Verify attendance appears in admin attendance view
features.evidence: E2E e2e/7-checkin-flow.spec.ts covers full QR check-in flow.
features.notes: QR displayed on admin share page.

features.name: Assignment Management
features.description: Per-session assignments with completion tracking and rate computation
steps: Open /admin/assignments, select an event
Create an assignment for a session
Mark a user as completed
Remove a completion
Verify completion rate matrix reflects changes
features.evidence: E2E e2e/8-admin-assignments.spec.ts (6 tests). Unit tests pass. Verified 2026-02-23.
features.notes: Completion matrix tracks per-user per-assignment status.

features.name: Teams
features.description: Team templates with default members/tasks, event team instantiation
steps: Open /admin/teams, create a team template
Add default members and default tasks to the template
Open /admin/events/[eventId], attach the team template to an event
Verify default members and tasks were cloned to event team
Add/remove event team members and tasks independently
features.evidence: E2E e2e/9-admin-teams.spec.ts (7 tests). Unit tests pass (36 tests). Verified 2026-02-23.
features.notes: Two-level model: templates are reusable, event teams are per-event instances.

features.name: Budget Tracking
features.description: Per-event budget items with estimated vs actual, summary with execution rate
steps: Open /admin/budget, select an event
Create a budget item with category and estimated amount
Update actual amount
Verify summary shows correct totals and execution rate
Delete a budget item
features.evidence: E2E e2e/10-admin-budget.spec.ts (6 tests). Unit tests pass. Verified 2026-02-23.
features.notes: Categories: MEAL, SNACK, VENUE, MATERIAL, EQUIPMENT, OTHER.

features.name: User Management
features.description: User listing, role assignment with expiration, account activation/deactivation
steps: Open /admin/users, verify user list loads
Change a user's role
Deactivate a user, verify they cannot access /admin
Reactivate the user, verify access restored
features.notes: Inactive users blocked from admin via middleware.

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Admin overview page and share page for event QR codes
steps: Open /admin, verify dashboard loads with overview subtabs
Switch between subtabs, verify content updates
Open /admin/share, verify QR code generation works
